input: Prepare me for a meeting with Monday.com (monday.com)

what_they_do.value: monday.com is the AI workspace where people lead and agents act, turning strategy into execution at scale.

priorities.evidence: AI credits, agents and vibe reached $36 million in AI annual recurring revenue as of Q3 ended September 30, 2026; management described the transition to an AI-first company as a fundamental evolution.

priorities.priority: Invest in enterprise sales and hands-on AI implementation.
priorities.evidence: The CFO identified enterprise go-to-market as an investment priority. Management also described launching monday Frontier, staffed by forward-deployed engineers, and continuing hiring for Frontier and sales into 2027.

priorities.priority: Expand enterprise infrastructure and work-management capacity.
priorities.evidence: The November 3 roadmap announced mondayDB-backed Datasets and Organization Hub for cross-account administration, both targeting general release in the first half of 2027; advanced portfolio and dashboard capabilities were in beta as of November 3, 2026.

priorities.priority: Make organizational AI governed and financially controllable.
priorities.evidence: The company highlighted granular agent permissions, human oversight, per-user spending limits, budget alerts and credit-usage visibility, alongside a shared directory for agents across the organization.

priorities.priority: Extend into enterprise voice AI for revenue teams.
priorities.evidence: Launched Harmony using voice technology acquired from OneAI, proprietary task-specific models, native CRM write-back and consent controls. At launch, it was available to mid-market and enterprise customers in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia and Singapore.

challenges.evidence: On November 9, the CRO said distraction from the workforce reduction lasted longer than expected. Headcount was 2,479 as of September 30, 2026, down 690 from the prior quarter; management expected growth effects into 2027.

challenges.challenge: Small-business pressure and longer buying cycles are slowing growth.
challenges.evidence: Management cited weaker small-business additions, increased churn described as intentional, and more deliberate purchasing as customers assess AI. Guidance issued November 9 projected approximately 14% Q4 revenue growth, versus 19% for Q3 ended September 30, 2026.

challenges.challenge: Customer-acquisition channels are becoming less predictable.
challenges.evidence: Management said its agentic acquisition experiment converted below expectations and spending was shifting toward events, field marketing and sales; discovery through AI rather than traditional search was adding self-serve funnel volatility.

recent_changes.headline: Latest results show AI traction alongside transition costs.
recent_changes.summary: For Q3 ended September 30, 2026, revenue was $377.5 million and non-GAAP operating margin was 24%. The company disclosed $10.0 million in net quarterly restructuring charges, including employee-related and facility costs.

recent_changes.headline: Elevate recap details enterprise-scale infrastructure and administration.
recent_changes.summary: Announced Datasets, Organization Hub and expanded work-management capacity, with general releases targeted for the first half of 2027 as of November 3, 2026. Recently released capabilities included List View and a workflow sandbox; roadmap timing is not a delivery commitment.

recent_changes.headline: Harmony launches for AI-powered sales conversations.
recent_changes.summary: monday.com launched a voice-agent platform covering prospecting, qualification, objection handling and transfers to human representatives, built on acquired OneAI voice technology and Twilio infrastructure.

recent_changes.headline: Elevate program emphasizes building working AI agents.
recent_changes.summary: Announced hands-on agent-building workshops, partner implementation support and customer awards focused on measurable workflow impact.

key_people.title: Co-founder and Co-CEO
key_people.recent: On September 29, 2026, emphasized helping customers build agents and integrate them into everyday work through Elevate.

talking_points: Where could an external partner best accelerate Frontier-led AI deployments without adding implementation overhead?
Which enterprise sales bottleneck matters most now: recovering execution after restructuring, proving AI value, or navigating longer buying decisions?
How are agent permissions, AI spending controls and Organization Hub shaping requirements for integrations and technology partners?

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
